fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: Pop set while shrunk: fails; the rest key is named before they start; the hint says the pivot did move, Edit > Undo first, then the rest key's time

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Before the try, Turn 2 names the rest key ('Pop is full size at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s'). The Turn 3 hint says the pivot did move even though it looked like nothing happened ('it did move Pop's pivot, far below it', and the tool gave outside_side 'below'), then asks for Edit > Undo first and only then the playhead on 4.3 s.
Turn 3 says what is off and where, using Pop, 3.3 s and 4.3 s, and hands the redo back to the learner ('Say done when it's there') without doing it or offering to.
Every name and time comes from tool output: Pop, Door with its left edge (suggested_place middle-left), 4.3 s (check_time) and 3.3 s (the check's time / item3.now).

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Before the attempt (Turn 2) the mentor named the rest key and time: "Pop is full size at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s". After the check (Turn 3) it said the pivot did move while Pop wasn't full size at 3.3 s, used "far below it" only because the tool gave outside_side "below", and asked for Edit > Undo before the playhead on 4.3 s.

Turn 3 says what is off and where (playhead at 3.3 s, Pop not full size, pivot far below) and gives only the sanctioned Edit > Undo and playhead-on-4.3 s hint, with no offer to fix it and no Pan Behind steps spelled out.

Every name and time the mentor uses appears in the tool results or the learner's message: Door and its left edge from the proposal (middle-left), Pop, 4.3 s from check_times and check_time, 3.3 s from the check's time, and "below" from outside_side.
